verdict: Volume is up this period; converting leads into booked patients is the priority.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered 128 leads at an average cost per lead of $10.94, with spend increasing sharply week-over-week as the awareness campaign scaled. That scale came at a price: spend rose 28.34% while leads grew only 13.33%, meaning each lead is costing more as volume climbs. The more pressing concern is what happens after a lead arrives — 108 opportunities are sitting in the pipeline with zero converted and zero appointments recorded this period, pointing to a gap in the intake process rather than the advertising. Tightening the handoff from lead to booked appointment is the active focus for the weeks ahead, and you should expect cost-per-lead to stabilize as we manage spend more precisely against efficiency targets.

watch_item.fix: We are working directly on the intake workflow to close that gap, with CRM calendar and patient grouping updates due by August 14.
